TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Cagayan de Tawi-Tawi
DATE 12 November 2028 · 0530 local
SIDE Philippine Navy
WINDOW 90 min, closes at 135
Rizal class patrol vessel. Photo: The Philippine Fleet (PF), Philippine Navy (PN) · Public domain · cropped
"Neither air superiority nor victory are American birthrights. Both are at significant risk."
- Gen. Mark Kelly, Commander, Air Combat Command, 2021

SULU SEA, 0530. Two coasters were sunk off Pearl Bank last week by drones that flew faster than anything the network has used before: Shahed 238s, the jet version. Signals put their yard on Cagayan de Tawi-Tawi, the island the charts call Mapun, a hundred and sixty miles from anywhere. The Air Force has imagery of two launchers and a rail at the south end of the island, and two guns.

MV Pag-asa Uno, chartered by the Navy with stores for Balabac, is fifty miles north-east of Mapun with BRP Artemio Ricarte. She cannot change her route without losing a day. Meridian's spotter drone flies from the same yard and is usually up by ten past the hour.
Tabak 11 and Tabak 12 are inbound from Puerto Princesa with precision bombs. Weapons Free on the yard. The village of Mapun is at the north end of the island and the fishing boats are off it.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Tactical Operations Group West, Philippine Air Force
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Destroy the drone launchers on Mapun before they fire on the charter. When their spotter goes up it will find her in minutes; after that every launcher left is a drone in the air. Take the guns if they shoot at you and the drone if you can. The village is at the north end of the island: put nothing there.
• Destroy the drone launchers on Mapun
• MV Pag-asa Uno is not lost
• Shoot down the spotter drone
• Silence the yard's guns
• Harm no fishing boat

Tabak 11 and 12, two FA-50PH out of Puerto Princesa; BRP Artemio Ricarte escorting the Navy charter MV Pag-asa Uno. Opposing: two Shahed 238 launchers, a Shahed-136 rail, two anti-aircraft guns and a spotter drone. Neutral: the Mapun fishing boats.

The planned window is 90 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 45 minutes more; the operation is closed at 135 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
